thread:
mira: Heads-up: Customer-driven ask from Acme Corp to run per-route quantized serving for their high-volume invoice extraction routes. They want a pilot next month. Need cross-team sequencing and explicit launch criteria.

alex: Runtime volunteer here. I'll implement quant profiles and numeric drift tests. ETA: 2 sprints. Need infra for separate quant node pools + dynamic kernel selection support.

tonY: Infra ops: can't mix quantized and fp32 on the same node pool. We'll provision a small quant pool and enforce traffic pinning via feature flags. Prewarm required. ETA: 1 sprint to provision and validate.

sarah_p: Security notes: artifact signing and provenance mandatory. We'll need per-tenant KMS keys and a quick privacy assessment for invoice data. I'll produce a checklist in 4 business days.

rachael: Product asks: Pilot with 3 customers (Acme first). Success criteria: >=5% token cost savings, median latency increase <10ms, zero correctness regressions on the eval set. Also require customer opt-in and rollback SLA of 30 mins.

dan: Platform/SDK: need a per-route pinning config plus fallback route that flips back to fp32. ETA: 1 sprint if requirements freeze today. I'll also add telemetry hooks.

infra-bot: capacity snapshot
```
region: us-west-2
available_quant_nodes: 20
available_fp32_nodes: 115
reserved_staging_nodes: 5
max_quant_mix_pct: 18
```

alex: Proposed rollout: 1) infra: create quant pool + flag; 2) runtime: add quant profiles + verification; 3) platform: route pinning + telemetry; 4) staging prewarm (48h); 5) canary: 5% -> 25% -> full. Security sign-off after step 2.

rachael: Product will prepare consent language and sample prompt/eval sets. Also want adoption metrics: tokens_served_quantized_pct per tenant and per-route.

tonY: Ops note: prewarm run necessary to measure cold-start P99. We'll schedule a 48-hour prewarm in staging. Also prepare rollback playbook.

alex: Add an automated perf gate: if canary P99 > baseline P99 *1.2 or quality fail triggered, auto-fail canary and rollback. Telemetry events: quant.canary.p99, quant.canary.quality_fail, quant.rollback.triggered.

dan: I'll prototype the route config proto and telemetry events today and share a short spec.

sarah_p: I'll check KMS access and artifact-signing pipeline for the pilot tenants; will flag any blockers.

mira: Owners: Alex (runtime), Tony (infra), Dan (platform), Sarah (security), Rachael (product). Blockers: infra pool, signed artifacts, telemetry. Next sync Thursday 11am PT for canary sign-off.

alex: Will publish a short rollout playbook with exact monitor queries and rollback commands before Thursday.

rachael: I'll message Acme and two other pilot customers for consent.

mira: Thanks all. Keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
